notes: Large-source-unit check: the three-morpheme `אֲשֶׁר` + `עֲלֵי` + `הֶם` → *whereupon* is retained; the suffix resumes the antecedent `הָעַמֻּדִים` and the one adverb carries both the relation and the resumption (rules 22, 30). Contrast v29, where the ASV writes *upon which* as two words and the suffix is left `unrepresented`.
The 1cs suffix on `הֲמִשֵׁנִי` takes the English subject pronoun *I* of the recast clause under rule 18; the verb is 2ms imperative, so rule 17's subject-pronoun permission does not reach that word.
Variant WLC.JDG.16.26.v005 is underdetermined and the projection carries r00-base; no new textual decision is taken here (rule 9).
